title: Midtown Nashville 4BR | Sleeps 12|Walk to Broadway
description:
Step into an unforgettable luxury Nashville stay at this stunning 4BR retreat, sleeps 12, in a prime downtown location near Broadway. Designed for elevated comfort, enjoy a spacious layout, big screen entertainment, and a sleek modern kitchen. With keyless entry, high-end finishes, and walkable access to top dining, nightlife, and live music, this is the ultimate upscale getaway for groups seeking the best of Music City.

The space
Welcome to The West End Wonder, your Nashville retreat in the heart of one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods! This modern 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers comfort, style, and Southern charm just minutes from Vanderbilt, Centennial Park, and all the hotspots of West End and Midtown.

Step inside to an open, sun-filled living area with cozy seating and Smart TVs for easy streaming. The fully stocked kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, plenty of counter space, and all the essentials to whip up a meal or enjoy a morning coffee before exploring the city.

Each bedroom is beautifully designed with plush bedding, spacious closets, and thoughtful touches to make you feel at home. The primary suite includes an en-suite bath and walk-in shower, perfect for relaxing after a night on Broadway.

Perfect for: families, groups, business travelers, and anyone looking to enjoy Nashville in comfort and style.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire home, including all four bedrooms, three bathrooms, the open-concept living area, and the fully equipped kitchen. You’ll also enjoy the private patio, in-home laundry, and free parking in the driveway or street.

Self check-in is available with a smart lock, so you can arrive at your convenience—no need to coordinate schedules. The space is yours to enjoy from check-in to check-out!

Other things to note
Smoking Fee - $250
